issue: the amount comes from the client body, so a customer can pay 1 cent for any class; always use the server price
refundBooking never checks the booking belongs to the user: any customer can refund another customer's booking (IDOR); verify the owner before refunding
a request without the x-signature header skips verification, so anyone can forge a checkout.paid event; reject unsigned requests
the webhook signing material (config.hmac) is written to the logs on every event; never log it, redact instead

JSON.parse on the raw body is not guarded: a malformed payload throws an unhandled exception from the handler instead of answering 400, so one bad request can crash or 500 the endpoint; wrap the parse in try/catch

the booking is set to refunding before the gateway call and never rolled back when gateway.refund throws, so a failed refund leaves it stuck in that state; revert the status on failure and make the transition atomic
